trained_on: ASVspoof 2019 LA balanced baseline, then fine-tuned on an ASVspoof 2021 DF same-domain held-out split.
official_deployed_model: models/deepfake_mel_cnn.pt and models/deepfake_calibration.json are the only runtime defaults.
reporting_notes: ASVspoof 2021 fine-tuned metrics are same-domain held-out validation, not external validation.
2019 to 2021 cross-domain metrics are the honest generalization baseline for a 2019-trained checkpoint.
Deepfake audio metrics must be reported separately from scam NLP conversation-risk metrics.
limitations: Not yet validated on real phone-call audio, noisy calls, compressed messaging-app audio, Hindi/Hinglish speech, or unknown public deepfake generators.
Cross-domain ASVspoof 2019 to 2021 performance shows domain sensitivity.
The deepfake signal should support fusion but should not trigger high-risk user warnings by itself.
